battle.name: 法荷戰爭
battle.theater: 荷蘭共和國西部與萊茵下游
battle.brief: 一六七二年，法王路易十四率大軍越萊茵河攻入荷蘭共和國，六月十二日自奈美根附近渡河，七月二十七日奧德納爾德淪陷、八月十六日格羅寧根淪陷，年底烏得勒支亦失，荷蘭遂稱「災難年」。火繩槍銃此時已退出野戰序列，只餘西班牙大方陣的火繩槍手與殖民地民兵仍在使用。

kit.name: 火繩槍銃
kit.history: 比步槍輕的長槍。西班牙人帶著它上船，也帶著它進了美洲。

countries: 法荷戰爭的交戰方是法國王國與荷蘭共和國，戰事同時在低地國家、西班牙尼德蘭、萊茵河下游與加勒比海四條線上展開。法國方面，王室直轄的「王室部隊」與貴族自帶的「私軍」並存，總指揮權集中在國王路易十四與陸軍大臣盧瓦手中；中軍由蒂雷納元帥統率，兩翼分給孔蒂親王與拉羅什福科公爵，圍城炮隊、野戰炮兵與工兵由工程總監沃邦統一編排，海軍則依柯爾貝爾的重建方案整頓，開始以主力艦與火船混編的突擊縱隊作戰。荷蘭方面是七省聯邦的「諸省聯邦議會」與荷蘭省共同主政，野戰軍由省級聯隊、聯邦僱傭兵與徵召民兵拼成，另有各城市的市民國民軍待命，其中阿姆斯特丹的民兵連隊由斧槍兵與火槍手混編；平時的指揮體系以荷蘭省的「常設委員會」與大總理約翰·德·維特為核心，危急時才把海陸軍總司令權交給大元帥威廉三世。法國拉攏到勃蘭登堡—普魯士與薩克森的援軍，荷蘭一方則有神聖羅馬帝國、西班牙與英格蘭加入戰團，荷蘭的守軍則遠及南非與美洲的殖民地據點。
countriesEn: The belligerents in the Franco-Dutch War were the kingdom of France and the Dutch Republic, and the fighting ran on four fronts at once: the Low Countries, the Spanish Netherlands, the lower Rhine and the Caribbean. On the French side the king's own Household troops and the private regiments raised by the great lords existed side by side, with supreme command concentrated in the person of Louis XIV and the war minister Louvois; the centre of the army was led by Marshal Turenne, the wings by the Prince of Conti and the duc de La Rochefoucauld, while the siege artillery, the field guns and the engineers were all organised by the director of fortifications Vauban. The navy, reorganised on Colbert's plans, had by this time been rebuilt into a force fighting in mixed squadrons of capital ships and fireships. On the Dutch side the States General of the seven provinces governed jointly with the province of Holland; the field army was pieced together from provincial companies, federal mercenaries and levies, with the citizen militias of the cities on standby, among them the kloveniers companies of Amsterdam, where halberdiers and musketeers were mixed in the same ranks. In normal times the conduct of the war lay with the permanent committee of Holland and the grand pensionary Johan de Witt; in extremity the command of the armies and fleets was handed to the stadtholder William III. France drew in troops from Brandenburg-Prussia and Saxony; the Dutch side was joined by the Holy Roman Empire, Spain and England, while Dutch garrisons stood as far off as South Africa and the American colonies.
people: 路易十四開戰時年僅二十四歲，剛親政不久，他需要一場對外勝利來把新王朝的威權夯實，於是自任全軍統帥、隨大軍渡過萊茵河，這是他一生最後一次親臨戰陣。此後他再也沒有站上火線，戰爭的運作改由盧瓦在後方籌畫、沃邦在前方解決，中軍的實際作戰由蒂雷納元帥承擔。荷蘭方面最關鍵的是大元帥威廉三世，他在海利格萊、於格德勒漢、阿爾登堡與卡塞爾一連串戰鬥中屢挫法軍，但真正改變局勢的是權力本身：他先在一六七二年六月被推為海陸軍總司令，七月六日更取得「一人獨裁」的授權，荷蘭省當局於是失去對戰爭的主導權；八月六日他的姻親科納留斯·德·維特在海牙受刑而死，二十一日大總理約翰·德·維特被暴民殺死，這兩件事成為荷蘭內部裂痕的頂點。海權方面，米歇爾·德·魯伊特是全軍倚重的統帥：開戰時他正護送英軍撤出加勒比海的聖基茨島，得知本土遭入侵後立即回航，於索爾灣與法國縱隊交戰，並在後續海戰中把荷蘭艦隊從崩潰邊緣拉回來。政界方面，阿姆斯特丹的市政要員科內利斯·德赫拉埃夫與安德里斯·德赫拉埃夫兄弟，在推動大元帥復出與廢除「常設委員會」上出力最多；勃蘭登堡—普魯士大選侯腓特烈·威廉同年六月與瑞典訂立同盟，他的部隊在海利格萊受挫，卻也在格羅寧根的圍攻中扮演了進攻的一方。
peopleEn: Louis XIV was only twenty-four when the war began, newly come to the personal exercise of power and in need of a foreign victory to consolidate the authority of a new reign; he took command of the army in person and crossed the Rhine with it, the last time he would ever stand on a battlefield. He never went back to the firing line, and the war was thereafter run by Louvois behind the front and solved by Vauban in front of it, with the practical command of the centre falling to Turenne. The decisive figure on the Dutch side was the stadtholder William III. He repeatedly beat the French at Heiligerlee, Ugdelegem, Aardenburg and Cassel, but what really changed the situation was the distribution of power: he was made commander of the armies and fleets in June 1672, and on 6 July received sole and supreme authority, which stripped the States of Holland of their control of the war; on 6 August his brother-in-law Cornelis de Witt was tortured to death in The Hague, and on 21 August the grand pensionary Johan de Witt was killed by a mob, the two deaths marking the depth of the Dutch domestic split. On the maritime side the commander on whom everything turned was Michiel de Ruyter: at the outbreak of war he was escorting the English garrison out of Saint Kitts in the Caribbean, and the moment he learned that the homeland was being invaded he turned back, fought the French squadron in the Battle of Solebay, and afterwards hauled the Dutch fleet back from the edge of collapse. In the government at Amsterdam, the brothers Cornelis and Andries de Graeff did most to bring the stadtholder back and to end the permanent committee. The Great Elector Frederick William of Brandenburg-Prussia concluded an alliance with Sweden in June of the same year; his troops were beaten at Heiligerlee, yet they also appear as the besiegers at Groningen.
kits: 火繩槍銃在一六七二年已經不是野戰序列裡的兵器，但它的位置並非空白，而是以兩種身分殘留：西班牙大方陣中的火繩槍手，以及殖民地民兵手上的守備槍。荷蘭與法國的野戰步兵在一六七二年都已經全面改用燧發步槍；荷蘭連隊仍維持長矛與火槍的混編，火槍手佔少數、長矛手佔多數，這種比例正是火繩槍時代留下的血統。西班牙方面的軍制在同一時期仍把火繩槍保留為大隊的固定兵種，每個約三千人的大隊內設火繩槍手連，與長矛連、普通步槍連並列；葡萄牙步兵同樣設有火繩槍手連，這一編制在十七世紀的伊比利亞半島與巴西都曾使用。火繩槍銃真正發揮作用的地方在加勒比海：一六七二年三月英軍放棄聖基茨島的查爾斯堡，荷蘭分遣隊護送守軍離島之後，島嶼轉入法國之手，島上守備民兵所用的正是這類火繩槍，在同一個月裡，它既是歐洲大陸戰爭的配角，也是海外據點的日常兵器。除火繩槍外，戰場上真正決定勝負的是炮兵與後勤。法軍在這一年裡投入的攻城火炮達數百門，野戰炮以十二磅與二十四磅為主，並有專門的火藥車隊與定點彈藥倉庫制度；渡河用舟船搭成的浮橋，圍城則靠壕溝、交通壕與逐段逼近的射擊術。荷蘭方面的關鍵是水：堤壩、閘門與在穆伊登及德雷赫特一帶開啟的水口，把萊茵蘭低地變成淺水，車隊與大炮在浮泥中寸步難行；他們的運補靠平底駁船與牛車在堤後小路上轉運，騎兵則以小股襲擾切斷法軍的糧道。
kitsEn: The arquebus was no longer a weapon of the line of battle in 1672, but its place was not blank: it survived in two guises, as the arquebusiers of the Spanish tercio and as the garrison gun of the colonial militia. The field infantry of both Holland and France had gone over completely to the flintlock musket by 1672; the Dutch company still mixed pike and shot, with the musketeers in the minority and the pikemen in the majority, a proportion that is the direct inheritance of the arquebus era. The Spanish military system of the same time still kept the arquebus as a fixed arm of the tercio, with a company of arquebusiers in each tercio of about three thousand men, standing beside the pike companies and the companies of ordinary soldiers; the Portuguese infantry likewise had arquebusier companies, a formation used in Iberia and in Brazil throughout the seventeenth century. The arquebus did its real work in the Caribbean: in March 1672 the English abandoned Fort Charles on Saint Kitts, a Dutch detachment escorted the garrison off the island, and the island passed to France, where the defending militia carried exactly this kind of gun; in the same month the weapon was a supporting actor in the European war and the everyday arm of the overseas garrisons. Apart from the arquebus, what decided battles was artillery and logistics. The French brought several hundred siege guns into the 1672 campaign, with field pieces of twelve and twenty-four pounds, and had a dedicated train of gunpowder wagons and a system of fixed magazine depots; the army crossed the river on a bridge of boats, and the sieges were carried by trenches, parallels and a creeping forward by fire. On the Dutch side the decisive factor was water: dikes, sluices and the openings made at Muiden and along the Drecht turned the Rhine country into shallow marsh, in which wagons and great guns could scarcely move; their supply went forward in flat-bottomed barges and by ox-cart along the paths behind the dikes, and their cavalry cut the French supply lines with constant small raids.
tactics: 法軍的戰術核心是炮兵加圍城。一六七二年路易十四刻意避免與荷蘭的野戰軍打會戰，把兵力與攻城器械集中起來，逐座奪取要塞：每到一城先築圍城線，切斷城內外交通，再用大炮遠程壓制，之後逐段進逼。這一季荷蘭境內與佛蘭德斯方面的圍城達二十餘次，沃邦主持的炮隊在同一時間內出現在數個方向，這種多點同時展開的圍城，只有背後有成熟彈藥補給線的軍隊才做得到。渡過萊茵河之後，法軍兵分數路：一路沿河向阿姆斯特丹方向推進，一路奪取通往安特衛普與布魯塞爾方向的城市。荷蘭人的應對是把國土變成武器。第一步是淹水：五月間打開穆伊登與德雷赫特一帶的閘門，萊茵蘭低地成了一片淺水，法軍先鋒的騎兵困在牧場上，後方車隊的車輪陷在泥中，攻城炮難以展開。第二步是省兵：荷蘭的野戰軍避免與法軍主力接戰，只在海利格萊、於格德勒漢與卡塞爾這幾個有把握的場合投入兵力，贏了就轉移。第三步是擾敵：一六七三年起，威廉三世的騎兵在范索爾姆伯爵率領下深入法軍後方，襲擊糧道與宿營地，洪斯霍特的一次襲擊幾乎摧毀法軍的浮橋與軍需車隊；城市民兵則負責守城、封鎖與維持城內秩序。水軍方面，荷蘭艦隊利用澤蘭省分隊在淺海與內河的經驗，以吃水淺的船隻與火船在索爾灣與斯赫弗寧根一帶活動，雖然在斯赫弗寧根損失慘重，卻也迫使法國無法在近岸長期控制水道。法軍的破綻出現在冬天：一六七二年底大軍停駐在沒有工事可攻的營地裡，就地劫掠，貴族軍官爭吵縱飲，士氣與補給同時下滑，這才讓荷蘭等到一六七三年的反攻窗口。
tacticsEn: The core of the French method was artillery plus siege. In 1672 Louis XIV deliberately avoided a general action with the Dutch field army, concentrating men and siege material to take the fortresses one at a time: at each town a line of circumvallation was dug to cut the place off, the guns opened at long range, and the approach was made by degrees. More than twenty sieges were conducted in Holland and Flanders in that single season, and Vauban's trains were at work in several directions at the same time, a parallelism only possible with a mature magazine line behind the army. After the crossing of the Rhine the French divided: one column pressed along the river towards Amsterdam, others took the towns on the road to Antwerp and Brussels. The Dutch answer was to turn the country itself into a weapon. The first step was drowning the land: in May the sluices at Muiden and along the Drecht were opened, the Rhine country became a sheet of shallow water, the French cavalry was caught on the pasture and the wagons of the column bogged in mud, so that the siege guns could not be brought into play. The second step was to husband the army: the Dutch field force avoided contact with the main French body and committed itself only where it was confident of success, at Heiligerlee, Ugdelegem and Cassel, breaking off as soon as it had won. The third step was harassment: from 1673 the cavalry of William III, led by Count van Solms, struck deep into the French rear, attacked depots and camp, and the raid at Hondschoote very nearly destroyed the French pontoon bridge and baggage train; the city militias meanwhile held towns, sealed the roads and kept order within the walls. At sea the Dutch fleet, drawing on the shallow-water experience of the Zeeland squadrons, worked the inner waters and the coast with shallow-draft craft and fireships around Solebay and Scheveningen, and although it was badly mauled at Scheveningen it prevented France from holding the coastal waters for long. The French weakness showed in the winter: by the end of 1672 the great army lay in camps with no works to assault, living off the country, with the noble officers given to quarrels and dissipation, and morale and supply falling together; that was the window the Dutch waited for before counter-attacking in 1673.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。開戰時間：一六七二年三月英格蘭向荷蘭宣戰，荷蘭與法國的戰爭隨即在六月全面爆發；法軍於六月十二日在奈美根附近以舟船浮橋渡過萊茵河，進入荷蘭國境。兵力：法軍投入的野戰部隊約十三萬至十四萬人，攻城火炮數百門，野戰炮以十二磅與二十四磅為主，圍城炮口徑更大；這支部隊是當時歐洲最龐大的單一軍力，同一季內的圍城達二十餘次。荷蘭方面，能夠投入的野戰兵力在數萬之數，另有各城市民兵待命，阿姆斯特丹等城市的常駐人口約二十萬。主要戰役日期：六月二十六日海利格萊（格羅寧根城郊），荷蘭得勝；六月三十日於格德勒漢，荷蘭再勝；七月三日阿爾登堡解圍；七月二十七日奧德納爾德淪陷；八月十一日卡塞爾，荷蘭得勝；八月十六日格羅寧根在勃蘭登堡—普魯士的圍攻下淪陷，是荷蘭全國震動最深的一擊；八月二十六日至九月六日聖文丹淪陷；十月間祖特芬、布拉達、格拉弗等城相繼失守；十二月九日伍爾登，荷蘭守軍在民眾協助下擊退法軍；十二月十二日烏得勒支開城，荷蘭約三分之一國土一度在法軍控制之下。海戰方面，六月二十八日索爾灣海戰，法荷雙方在澤蘭海峽互有勝負，荷蘭未受重創；法軍用火船強攻、荷蘭以火船反擊的戰法也在這一戰定型。損失：荷蘭方面陣亡與被俘合計以萬計，被俘者多於戰死；法軍在荷蘭境內佔領約一半國土，但始終沒有拿下阿姆斯特丹，到一六七四年夏，聯軍反攻迫使法軍全面撤出荷蘭本土。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. In time: England declared war on the Dutch in March 1672 and the war between France and Holland opened in full in June; the French crossed the Rhine on a bridge of boats near Nijmegen on 12 June and entered Dutch territory. In strength: the French field force numbered about one hundred and thirty to one hundred and forty thousand men, with several hundred siege guns, the field pieces being chiefly twelve- and twenty-four-pounders and the siege pieces of larger calibre; this was the largest single army assembled in Europe up to that time, and more than twenty sieges were fought within the single season. The Dutch could bring a field force of some tens of thousands, with the city militias on standby, and the permanent population of Amsterdam and other cities was about two hundred thousand. Dates of the principal actions: 26 June, Heiligerlee, fought outside Groningen, won by the Dutch; 30 June, Ugdelegem, won by the Dutch; 3 July, the relief of Aardenburg; 27 July, the fall of Oudenaarde; 11 August, Cassel, won by the Dutch; 16 August, the fall of Groningen to the siege of Brandenburg-Prussia, the blow that shook the whole republic most deeply; 26 August to 6 September, the fall of Saint-Venant; in October the loss of Zutphen, Breda and Grave; 9 December, Woerden, where the Dutch repulsed the French with the help of the townspeople; and 12 December, the surrender of Utrecht, at the height of which about a third of Dutch territory was under French control. At sea, the Battle of Solebay on 28 June left both fleets in the Zuiderzee damaged but unbroken, and the tactics of the French fireship assault met by the Dutch counter-charge of fireships were settled in that engagement. Losses: on the Dutch side the killed and captured together ran into the tens of thousands, with more prisoners than dead; the French held about half the country of the Netherlands, but never took Amsterdam, and by the summer of 1674 were forced to withdraw completely from Dutch territory.
cause: 打起來的原因有遠有近。遠的一層是王權與歐洲權力格局：一六七〇年路易十四與英王查爾斯二世訂立密約，答應協助英國奪取西班牙王位，並由英格蘭出錢支持法國攻取荷蘭與西班牙尼德蘭；荷蘭因為得到一六六八年「三重同盟」的支持，拒絕在法國對西班牙的戰爭中提供援手，法國便把荷蘭視為必須先摧毀的障礙。一六七一年法國頒布關稅與航運法令，限制荷蘭船隻承載法國貨物，直接打擊荷蘭的商業命脈，是開戰前最後一根導火線。近的一層是荷蘭內部的政策分歧。約翰·德·維特領導的「常設委員會」主張對法綏靖，以荷蘭省的安全為先，反對把國運押在戰爭上；威廉三世一方則認為荷蘭的獨立與歐洲均勢不容法國坐大，雙方在海牙長期角力。當法軍越過萊茵河的消息傳來，政策分歧立刻變成生死鬥：六月十三日大元帥被任命為海陸軍總司令，七月六日「一人獨裁」的授權讓他掌握了戰爭與外交，荷蘭省議會被架空，大總理與其弟相繼慘死。宗教並非這場戰爭的主因，但荷蘭加爾文派把戰爭視為信仰與自由的保衛戰，各城的教會與民兵因此自發組織守土，這一點使荷蘭的抵抗比單純的政府動員更為頑強。
causeEn: There were distant and immediate reasons for the war. The distant one was kingship and the balance of European power: in 1670 Louis XIV concluded a secret treaty with Charles II, promising to support the English claim to the Spanish throne, with English money paying for the French attack on Holland and the Spanish Netherlands; the Dutch, who had the support of the Triple Alliance of 1668, refused to assist France in her war against Spain, and France therefore came to treat Holland as an obstacle that had to be destroyed first. In 1671 the French issued their tariff and navigation ordinances restricting the carriage of French goods in Dutch ships, which struck directly at the commercial life of the Republic and was the last fuse before the war. The immediate cause lay in a Dutch domestic dispute over policy. The permanent committee under Johan de Witt favoured accommodation with France, putting the security of Holland first and resisting a policy that gambled the country's fate on a war; William III and his party held that Dutch independence and the European balance of power could not be allowed to collapse before France, and the two camps had been fighting each other in The Hague for years. When the news of the crossing of the Rhine came, the policy dispute turned into a struggle for life: on 13 June the stadtholder was made commander of the armies and fleets, and on 6 July the grant of sole authority put the war and the diplomacy in his hands, the States of Holland was set aside, and the grand pensionary and his brother were killed. Religion was not the main cause of the war, but the Calvinists of the Netherlands held it to be a defence of faith and of freedom, and the churches and militias of the cities organised the defence of the soil on their own initiative, which is why the Dutch resistance was more stubborn than a purely governmental mobilisation.
impact: 一六七二年在荷蘭叫作「災難年」，在法國則是路易十四個人威望的最高點與轉捩點。法國這一季的軍事成功空前：十三四萬大軍、數百門攻城炮，兩三個月內打下二十餘座城市，把荷蘭共和國的心臟地帶幾乎全部佔領。但佔領的代價立刻顯現：法軍把兵分得太散，圍城線拉得太長，荷蘭的抵抗又以水為盾；一六七二年底大軍陷入冬季停滯，貴族軍官在營地裡爭吵與縱飲，士氣崩落，連國王本人也感到威信受損。此後他再也沒有親自上戰場，法國的對外戰爭改由盧瓦與沃邦在幕後運作，權力愈發集中於凡爾賽宮。對荷蘭而言，災難年反而是國家結構的重整。威廉三世由「臨時代理」變成荷蘭省的終身大元帥，再由一六七四年起成為聯邦的終身大元帥，「舊寡頭」政治時代告終，國家權力向中央集中，用來應付常備軍與財政的機構也跟著建立。國際上，這場戰爭讓荷蘭明白單靠商業與海上力量無法單獨對抗法國，於是全力經營歐洲同盟，最終在一六七四年組成包括英格蘭、瑞典、勃蘭登堡、荷蘭與西班牙在內的反法聯盟，也在制度上確立了歐洲均勢的觀念，荷蘭由此從「商業共和國」變成歐洲外交與財政的重要支柱。帝國遠洋端，荷蘭在美洲與亞洲的據點因戰事被英法趁隙奪走一批，荷屬巴西、亞洲據點與加勒比海貿易都受挫，一六七二年前後英法在海外的勝負也直接改變了荷蘭的航線與殖民地版圖。
impactEn: The year 1672 is called the Disaster Year in the Netherlands, and in France it was both the high point of Louis XIV's personal prestige and the turning point. The French military success that season was unmatched: an army of a hundred and thirty to a hundred and forty thousand and several hundred siege guns took more than twenty cities in two or three months and occupied very nearly the whole heart of the Dutch Republic. But the price of the occupation showed at once: the French spread their troops too thin and their lines of circumvallation too long, and the Dutch opposition used water as its shield; by the end of 1672 the great army was bogged down in its winter quarters, the noble officers quarrelled and drank in the camps, morale collapsed, and the king himself felt his prestige dented. He never took the field again, and from then on the wars were directed by Louvois and Vauban in the background, with power concentrating further at Versailles. For the Dutch the Disaster Year was a reconstruction of the state. William III passed from lieutenant of the provinces to stadtholder for life of Holland, and from 1674 stadtholder for life of the States General; the era of the old oligarchy was over, power moved to the centre, and the machinery of a standing army and of finance was built to match. Internationally, the war taught the Dutch that commerce and sea power alone could not hold off France; they built a system of European alliances and formed, in 1674, the anti-French league of England, Sweden, Brandenburg, Holland and Spain, and in doing so institutionalised the idea of the balance of power, so that the Republic moved from being a trading republic to a pillar of European diplomacy and finance. At the far end of the empire the war cost the Dutch a number of overseas possessions taken by the English and the French while the home front was in crisis, and the balance of the contest in the Americas and Asia in and around 1672 changed the Dutch sea lanes and the colonial map.
result: 打完了，荷蘭沒有亡國，法國也沒有拿到荷蘭。直接結果是法軍在一六七三年底至一六七四年初被逐出荷蘭本土：荷蘭的反攻在大元帥率領下展開，帝國、勃蘭登堡與西班牙的部隊在萊茵河一線站穩陣腳，法軍因補給線過長與士氣低落而節節撤退，德國西南部的城鎮重新回到聯盟手中。荷蘭的土地、堤壩與港口回到自己手中，但代價是國民經濟的重創、大批房屋與農田被毀、菁英分子的死亡，以及長期的軍費負擔。一六七八年的《尼斯條約》為這場戰爭畫上句號：法國歸還多數西班牙尼德蘭的城市，荷蘭取得邊界與約定的現狀保障，法國則得到真正的戰略收穫——洛林的併吞，法國的東部邊界從此深入帝國心臟。對荷蘭而言，結果是政治上由威廉三世及其後的奧蘭治王朝主導，重建後的軍隊與艦隊成為歐洲海上最有力的力量之一；對法國而言，結果是荷蘭的海上霸權受挫卻未被摧毀，而法國的絕對君主制在一次次圍城勝利中定型，並把注意力轉向西班牙王位問題，之後的歐洲衝突都由此衍生。這場戰爭留下的最大教訓，是荷蘭的防守、法國的攻堅，以及所有以炮兵與工程決定勝負的後來戰爭。
resultEn: The war ended with the Netherlands still in existence and France still without Holland. The immediate result was that the French were driven out of Dutch territory between the end of 1673 and the beginning of 1674: the Dutch counter-attack under the stadtholder was joined by imperial, Brandenburg and Spanish troops which took their stand on the Rhine line, and the French, whose supply lines were too long and whose morale had failed, fell back step by step, regaining the towns of south-west Germany for the coalition. The Dutch got their land, their dikes and their harbours back, but paid for it with a wrecked economy, destroyed houses and fields, the deaths of the political elite, and a long military burden. The Treaty of Nijmegen of 1678 closed the matter: France returned most of the Spanish Netherlands, Holland obtained its frontiers and the agreed guarantee of the status quo, and France took the real prize of the war, the annexation of Lorraine, so that its eastern frontier drove deep into the heart of the empire. For the Dutch the result was a state directed by William III and afterwards by the Orange dynasty, with an army and a navy rebuilt into one of the strongest maritime forces in Europe; for France it was a Dutch maritime power checked but not broken, while the absolutism of Louis XIV was hardened by a series of victories by siege, and turned its attention to the Spanish succession, from which the later European conflicts all grew. The greatest lesson of the war was given by the defence of the Dutch, by the siegecraft of the French, and by every later war in which artillery and engineering decided the issue.
